remarks: Welcome to this terrific one bedroom condo in the heart of dynamic Springdale! A nice entry foyer leads to the generously sized living room, offering wood flooring, a dining area with ceiling fan and access to the private balcony where you can enjoy some time outdoors! The kitchen has white cabinetry, granite counters and stainless-steel appliances. The large primary bedroom with wood flooring, has a nicely sized closet and also offers access to the balcony. There is also a newly renovated full bathroom and newer hot water heater. A laundry room conveniently located in the unit, offers a washer/dryer and additional storage space. There is covered parking under the building, space #1 belongs to this unit. All of this and such a convenient location! Just across from the Springdale Metro North train stop, close to shopping, restaurants and minutes to downtown vibrant Stamford! A great place to call home!
